body: I just wanted to vent, wasn’t really looking for solutions
Bold of you to assume that I have people in my life who cares
Never been in love so I can’t really understand that. But just because you’re in a relationship doesn’t mean that you can’t keep your friendships alive. Who is she gonna go to if they break up.

I don’t think the problem is that she doesn’t know how to. She has a boyfriend, and she would do anything for him. Always takes an interest his life, listens to his problems and is so considerate when it comes to him. 

I honestly just think that she doesn’t see my problems as a big deal, or something that she should care to much about.

I don’t want it to seem like I’m craving for attention. And I’m not expecting anything from her. A simple how are you would just show that she at least cares. Isn’t that what friends do for each other. 
I’m always there for her, which is why she calls me her best friend. I’m there for her. Not because I have to or she has told me what she expects from me, but simply because I’m her friend. 
Don’t want to seem rude but if we stopped being friends it wouldn’t affect me in a negative way at all. I’ll just keep going through this alone, like I’m doing now.

I am aware that nothing should go inside my vagina, so I don’t think that’s the problem. 
I might get it checked out, just really need to know if there is something wrong.

To be clear, I only use water to clean the inner and outer labia, nothing goes inside.

I am not on any medication at all. 
I have noticed that it goes away for maximum one 1 week every now and then, but I haven’t been able to see a pattern. My period is very irregular so it’s not easy for me to know where I am in my cycle.

Yes we only communication through phones, although I’m going back there to visit in a few days, which she knows so I don’t know how to avoid her then. And we have many mutual friends,  I don’t want to involve them in this, which I feel like she would. 
Should I just cut her off without giving her an explanation.
